decisions.summary: Flag rename is a fallback read: isMergeTrainEnabled() reads merge_train.enabled, falls back to legacy flywheel.merge_train_enabled when unset; setMergeTrainEnabled() writes only the new key. No data migration — the flag is ON in production and must survive deploy.

Per-project override merge_train?: 'enabled'|'disabled' on ProjectConfig (absent = follow global), mirroring auto_merge_default. Resolution helper isMergeTrainEnabledForProject(projectKey) lives in src/lib/cloister/auto-merge-policy.ts and gates BOTH the UAT train reconciler and the post-merge sibling reconciler (runMergeTrainReconcile).

Ready set sources from getAllReviewStatusesFromDb() filtered by mergeGateEligibility().eligible && deaconIgnored !== true (the readyForMerge boolean can be stale; the predicate is authoritative per PAN-1759), grouped via resolveProjectFromIssueSync. The MERGE_GATE_VERBS verb filter is dropped; the verb-based computeMergeQueue wrapper and MERGE_GATE_VERBS are deleted in remove-legacy-routes IF grep -rn MERGE_GATE_VERBS src/ shows only test references remaining.
No module file renames — src/lib/flywheel-merge-order.ts keeps its path (surgical-changes rule; the issue's coupling list is flag/data-source/UI, not file names).

New API is the aggregate /api/merge-train/* namespace (queues/generations return all projects; mutations take project or generation-name params). Legacy /api/flywheel merge-train routes are removed in the final remove-legacy-routes bead AFTER the frontend beads migrate — no aliases (dashboard frontend is the only consumer), and every intermediate bead leaves a working tree.

Multi-project view hosts on the Awaiting Merge page; the Flywheel page stays one viewer; no new top-level page. Project cockpit gets the per-project segmented control plus a compact summary (ready count + current generation name/status) linking to Awaiting Merge.

Generation label stays the project issue prefix (codenameLabel) — uat_generations.name is a global PRIMARY KEY and prefix-distinct labels make cross-project name collisions structurally impossible. Keep an invariant comment at codenameLabel.

UAT stack frontend host resolves from the project's dns domain config (dns lives on WorkspaceConfig, src/lib/projects.ts:32-52) with pan.localhost fallback; non-PAN stack support beyond URL resolution is best-effort.

Scope is baked into the flywheel run prompt at start/resume (flywheel-actions.ts:223,294). Persist effective scope on the run record; all UI copy states scope changes apply at the next run start or resume; configured-vs-run mismatch is made visible.

The pure reconciler (reconcileUatGenerations) keeps its existing per-projectRoot interface; multi-project iteration happens only in the service wiring (uat-train.ts). Everything below the service layer is already multi-project-capable.

hazards.summary: Production currently runs with the merge-train flag ON under the legacy key; the rename must not flip it off.
hazards.mitigation: Fallback read in isMergeTrainEnabled() (flag-rename.ac1 tests an ON value stored only under the old key). Verify live after merge.

hazards.summary: Blast radius: after decoupling, the global flag reaches every tracked project with ready work — git fetch/worktree/branch-push in THEIR repos every 60s tick.
hazards.mitigation: Per-project 'disabled' override is the safety valve; the idle-skip rule (zero git calls when ready set empty AND no live generations) is the noise guard — but a project with live generations and an empty ready set MUST still proceed so invalidation runs (reconciler-decouple.ac3).

hazards.summary: The post-merge path must stay idempotent (PAN-328 infinite-loop history, 24k tracker calls).
hazards.mitigation: tests/unit/lib/cloister/in-flight-guard.test.ts must stay green; promote keeps firing post-merge through the in-flight guard exactly once per member.

hazards.summary: Stale/cancelled tracker issues can linger in review-status records looking eligible.
hazards.mitigation: deaconIgnored exclusion + the branch-existence check inside computeMergeQueueFromCandidates are the backstops. Do NOT add tracker API calls to the ready-set hot path (it runs every 60s).

hazards.summary: uat_generations.name is a global PK; two projects could theoretically collide on a generation name.
hazards.mitigation: Label = issue prefix makes names prefix-distinct per project (uat/pan-* vs uat/min-*). Invariant comment required at codenameLabel (D7).

hazards.summary: Browser-based verification is required for the dashboard beads (Awaiting Merge view, cockpit control, Flywheel viewer, settings scope select).
hazards.mitigation: Playwright must use an isolated browser instance/profile; never depend on another agent's session or shared browser state; any login/setup must be reproducible inside the isolated session.

hazards.summary: A prior planning session (2026-06-11) left a sequence-2 workspace spec that was never promoted (no main-side spec existed).
hazards.mitigation: This session superseded it with sequence 3, incorporating its route-removal-as-final-bead ordering and empty-ready-set invalidation AC. No beads existed from the prior session.

claimHistory.reason: Flag key renamed to merge_train.enabled with legacy fallback support, unit tests pass
Per-project override in projects.yaml.merge_train.enabled, isMergeTrainEnabledForProject helper, runMergeTrainReconcile updated
Refactored getReadySet() to source from review-status DB; removed flywheel-run dependency
Refactored UAT train reconciler to be per-project independent with getReadySetForProject, assembleFromReadySetForProject, and makeCleanupForProject factory

Added src/dashboard/server/routes/merge-train.ts with the aggregate namespace: GET queues (per-project key/name/effective-flag/queue from the review-status ready set, no flywheel run), GET generations (per-project chains), POST generations/:name/stack and /promote (same handlers, uat/ prefix reconstruction, auth gate, firePostMergeLifecycle), POST assemble (one project or all), POST merge-next {n,project} with 404 on unknown key. Composed the layer in server.ts, registered all six routes in NO_LOSS_MATRIX, and added 16 route tests. Legacy flywheel routes untouched per D5.

Added components/merge-train/MergeTrainView.tsx: shared multi-project merge-train body reading only /api/merge-train/queues and /api/merge-train/generations, one section per project preserving every old-card behavior (batches, stack, promote, rebuild, held-out, What-to-UAT, ready-feature rows, escape hatch), project-scoped actions behind the same confirms, and filter chips persisted under localStorage merge-train.projectFilter. 21 tests. Deviation: kept the /api/flywheel/merge-backend capability probe so the 'merge backend unavailable' warning is not lost; a test asserts no flywheel run/state or legacy endpoint is fetched. ac4 browser verification deferred to fe-awaiting-merge, which mounts the view.

AwaitingMergePage now hosts MergeTrainSection (shared MergeTrainView + global merge_train_enabled toggle via /api/flywheel/config) above the per-issue rows; all per-row actions untouched. Browser-verified in an isolated Playwright chromium against a throwaway stub API: 3 project sections incl. an explicit 'merge train off' row, batches/held-out/checklist/escape hatch, toggle state, and filter persistence surviving a reload; zero console errors. ALSO fixed 8 tests left red by this branch's earlier fe-cockpit-toggle commit (missing merge-train endpoint in 3 strict fetch mocks, stale call-count, and two buttons sharing the accessible name 'Global default' — now scoped aria-labels). Extracted the page's API helpers to awaitingMergeApi.ts to satisfy the file-size guard, dropping the page under the god-file ceiling. Left alone: the page's pre-existing EmptyState still says 'The flywheel is idling — run /all-up' (per-issue empty state, outside this item).

MergeQueueCard is now a thin RailCard shell around the shared MergeTrainView (457 to 34 lines), reading only /api/merge-train/*; run-active gating removed (FlywheelPage passes active unconditionally, and active controls polling only, not whether reads happen). Extracted useMergeTrainData/mergeTrainTotals so the card labels its header from the same payloads. The page's Merge train ToggleSwitch is untouched and still posts merge_train_enabled; FlywheelConversationPane needed no change (no legacy endpoints). Card tests rewritten for the wrapper contract. Browser-verified at 460px rail width with no run data: aggregate endpoints only, zero legacy, correct cross-project count, zero console errors.

Scope now persists on FlywheelLaunchMetadata (written at start, re-stamped on resume when the configured value changed) and is restamped onto the status from launch metadata on every write, so the orchestrator's own POSTs cannot forge or erase it; exposed as optional fields on the FlywheelStatus contract and FlywheelRunDetail. Pane shows a live run's own scope via new pure resolveDisplayedScope(), falls back to the configured value with no run, surfaces a configured-vs-run mismatch in amber, and carries the 'applies at the next run start or resume' note. Also added an aria-label to the Run config card (its accessible name was the whole config dump, so 'resume' in the new note collided with the Resume button query). 14 new tests.

Verified the scope select already renders without expansion (block gated on role.id, not isExpanded) and locked it with a test. Added per-value help text plus an explicit line separating orchestrator scope from per-project merge-train enablement. Corrected the blanket 'apply on the next tick' copy so scope is stated to apply at the next run start or resume. ac3 was already covered by the existing round-trip test. Browser-verified with zero interaction in an isolated Playwright chromium: select + both copy lines visible on arrival, nothing expanded, and selecting all-tracked-projects round-trips through settings PUT/GET and switches the help text. 3 new tests.

roles/flywheel.md now defines both scope values where the Scope: config line is interpreted: pan-only keeps the PAN inventory verbatim; all-tracked-projects inventories every projects.yaml project under the same pickup gate/DECISIONS vetting/exclusions, with the author-assignee safety gate stated per tracker as a hard filter (GitHub gates verbatim; Linear = operator-assigned only). The Observe step now scopes its inventory instead of hardcoding PAN. Added the explicit statement that merge/UAT trains assemble per project regardless of run scope (orchestrator observes, never gates), that cross-project batches do not exist, and that scope is baked in at start/resume.

Deleted all six legacy /api/flywheel merge-train routes plus dead helpers and layer entries (flywheel.ts 1005->857, now under the god-file ceiling); config and auto-merge routes untouched. Applied D3: computeMergeQueue + MERGE_GATE_VERBS deleted, contracts verb comment rewritten to review-status sourcing, orphaned CLI import dropped. FOUND AND FIXED an unlisted live consumer: FeatureItem.tsx fetched the removed uat-generations for its train chip; now reads the aggregate namespace and flattens per-project chains (non-PAN issues get a chip for the first time). No-loss: 6 matrix entries re-registered as RELOCATE naming their successors; the PAN-1691 merge-order/stop-at-failure and internal-token auth tests PORTED to merge-train.test.ts; the PAN-1759 eligibility-gate test rewritten against listEligibleCandidatesByProject (which had no coverage) instead of dropped; MERGE_GATE_VERBS tests deleted as a retired contract. Also retargeted 2 Playwright specs (one in CI) and stale comments, retargeted the not-yet-served merge.ts design paths rather than deleting design surface, and fixed a prompt-invariant regression my earlier scope wording caused (my text contained the PAN-2229 rail's anchor phrase 'author/assignee gate').

UAT-BATCH-TRAINS.md: Ready-set row rewritten for per-project review-status sourcing with no run required, API table rewritten for /api/merge-train/* with the shapes that actually ship, 'Operating it' de-coupled from the active run and describing the per-project effective flag + idle-skip rule, new Multi-project shape section; 'active flywheel run' no longer appears. MERGE-TRAIN.md §7 gains a resolved-by-PAN-1696 (2026-06) note mapping each coupling to its fix, text kept verbatim as the record. FLYWHEEL.md gains an 'Orchestrator scope vs merge-train independence' section stating cross-project batches remain out of scope, plus corrections to the merge section's active-run framing and the Settings Scope row.
